title: Add /models/:id/introspect and publishable profile schema for versioned models
creator: Aisha Patel
description: We need a stable, discoverable API surface that lets consumers introspect a model's declared capabilities and fetch a published performance profile tied to a specific model version. This will enable: (1) runtime routing decisions (fallbacks and pinning), (2) console and SDK validation of config (max_tokens/context), and (3) autoscaler and cost tooling to pick batching/quantization profiles by workload. The design must be backward compatible with the manifest endpoints and support gradual publication from research/QA teams to production-verified profiles.
acceptance_criteria: New GET /models/:id/introspect returns declared capabilities, supported features, and current default version metadata
New GET /models/:id/versions/:version/profile returns a published performance profile (latency p50/p90, throughput, memory footprint, quantization recommendations, hardware affinity)
Profiles are stored with immutable version binding and a publication timestamp and can be rolled back/marked deprecated
Consumer SDKs and Console fetch the introspect endpoint without schema changes to existing manifest consumers (backwards compatible)
E2E tests validate schema shape, required fields, and fallback behavior when a profile is missing
Performance tests show profile fetch latency < 50ms p95 from regional edge cache for common requests
Docs and migration guide published for integrators using model pinning and rollout policies
technical_notes: Schema must include flat fields only (no nested objects in this ticket) for discovery: supported_features (list), limits (map-like string list), default_version (string), version_tags (list)
Profile payload must include p50_latency_ms, p90_latency_ms, tokens_per_sec, peak_gpu_memory_mb, recommended_quantization (e.g. q8_0/q4f16), bench_batch_sizes (CSV string), validated_hardware (list)
Profiles are write-once per (model_id, version, profile_id) and append-only. Publication flow: draft -> published -> deprecated. Each state change emits audit log events to the manifest topic

Version pinning semantics: /models/:id/introspect returns supported_pin_strategy: [exact, minor-compatible, latest-fallback]. When a model is pinned to a version, the runtime should consult the published profile for scheduling heuristics
Cache strategy: edge cache TTL=300s, invalidation on profile publish/deprecate via manifest-change webhook. Must include ETag support for conditional GETs
Auth scope: models:read for introspect, models:write for publishing/deprecating profiles. Publishing endpoint gated behind feature flag and requires a signed release token for initial rollout

Storage: profiles persisted to catalog DB (immutable records) and mirrored to the CDN for low-latency reads. Backfill task to populate profiles for existing catalog entries must run in the pre-launch window
api_schema_changes: GET /models/:id/introspect -> {model_id, default_version, supported_features: [streaming, embeddings, function_calling, structured_output], limits: ["max_tokens=8192", "max_input_tokens=8000"], supported_pin_strategy}

GET /models/:id/versions/:version/profile -> {profile_id, version, published_at, p50_latency_ms, p90_latency_ms, tokens_per_sec, peak_gpu_memory_mb, recommended_quantization, bench_batch_sizes, validated_hardware}
POST /models/:id/versions/:version/profile -> publish a profile (internal API only, requires release token). Request body accepts same flat keys as profile response plus maintainer & validation_notes
PATCH /models/:id/versions/:version/profile/:profile_id/deprecate -> mark profile deprecated (internal only). Deprecation must include replacement_profile_id optional field
Compatibility: /models/:id/manifest remains unchanged. Introspect returns a manifest_ref to preserve backwards linkage
rollout_plan: 1) Merge API and DB schema changes behind feature flags (catalog.profile_read, catalog.profile_write)
2) Deploy read endpoint to staging and seed with synthetic profiles for internal QA
3) Enable shadow reads in runtime: runtime fetches profile but does not yet use it for scheduling; collect telemetry for 2 weeks
4) Open internal beta: enable publishing on a small set of models (research-use) and validate CDN mirroring and cache invalidation
5) Controlled rollout to customers: enable profile-based routing for non-critical routes and monitor cost/latency regressions
6) Full enablement: SDK and Console switch to prefer published profiles for autoscaling and recommendation UIs
risks: Stale or incorrect published profiles could cause the autoscaler to under-provision or oversubscribe hardware
Breaking changes to existing manifest consumers if we add required fields; ensure all new fields are optional at first
Race conditions during publish/deprecate could cause inconsistent ETag cache behavior; require strong ordering in the publish API
Security: publishing pathway could be abused to surface misleading capabilities if auth is misconfigured
comments: 2025-02-10 Aisha Patel: Initial triage and scoping. Identified need to keep /manifest backward compatible. Assigned to Marco.
2025-02-12 Marco Liu: Sketch of response schema posted to #model-catalog. Key decision: publish immutably and deprecate via explicit API to avoid silent regressions.
2025-02-14 Performance lab: baseline runs on rtx-a100: p50=18ms, p90=42ms at batch=1 for sample-7B model. Added as a sample profile to staging.
2025-02-16 Design review: UX for Console cost recommendations requires bench_batch_sizes and tokens_per_sec fields. Design approved with minor wording updates.
2025-02-18 Marco Liu: API PR opened (serving#2231). Shadow-read instrumentation added to runtime; telemetry receiving expected fields. Requesting architecture review before merge.
